jobs.title: GIS Specialist
jobs.description:
GIS Specialist, Raleigh, NC, US

Technical Specialist- Junior

NCDIT-Transportation (NCDIT-T) GIS Team is seeking a Technical Specialist – Junior that will provide dedicated support the State Traffic Operations Center (STOC) and Transportation Mobility & Safety Unit by assisting with maintaining and updating GIS data used in routing, traffic operations, and incident response. This role works with TM&S staff to understand basic workflow needs, assist with gathering requirements, and help build simple to moderately complex maps, dashboards, and GIS tools that support daily operations. The primary focus is to communicate clearly with non-GIS users, ask questions to understand requests, and follow established GIS Unit standards when creating or updating data and applications. Daily work includes editing geometry, updating events and attributing data, performing QA/QC checks, and assisting with progress tracking and documentation. The role may also support Arcade coding and help with ETL processes under guidance from more senior team members.

This position will require an advanced knowledge of ArcGIS Online, the Esri Software Suite, and ArcGIS Enterprise. The candidate must be able to build web mapping applications independently, publish hosted and referenced feature services, and understand the life cycle of GIS products from requirements gathering to databases, schema creation, cartography, application development, and maintenance.

Note: Candidates must be willing and able to perform 12+ hour days in the event of a major emergency activation, including evenings, weekends, and holidays. The ideal candidate will be able to travel to and from the STOC in Raleigh for in-person support during a major activation lasting >5 days. The State will not cover this travel expense, and it must be budgeted and supplied by the contracting firm. Candidates will be paid a flat hourly rate during approved overtime hours, if required. Preference will be given to candidates that live within <1 hour commute to STOC.

The ideal candidate will be able to shadow meetings, listen to issues, and independently identify potential GIS solutions based on complex issues. The ability to quickly generate solutions and describe them to non-IT personnel is essential to this role. Documentation, organization, and communication skills are required. This position will report to the Specialist – Expert position and must be able to take direction and work collaboratively extremely well, both in person, and remotely.

A sample of work is required as part of the submission for this position. A sample of work can include documentation of a GIS process, a cartographic map, a report on a GIS solution, or a link to a GIS application in which the candidate was the primary creator/developer.

Role/Responsibilities

Update and maintain GIS data by editing geometry, events, and attributes to support STOC and TM&S operations.
Perform routine QA/QC checks to ensure data accuracy and follow established GIS Unit workflows and standards.
Assist in creating and updating basic to moderate complexity maps, dashboards, and GIS tools used for routing, signal operations, incident response, and situational awareness.
Work with TM&S staff to understand their requests, ask clarifying questions, and document requirements in a clear and simple way.
Write basic Arcade code to support mapping, queries, calculations, and display.
Support ETL processes under guidance from senior GIS staff, helping keep data and applications up to date.
Attend STOC meetings to observe workflows and learn operational needs, gradually building the context needed to support the future GIS solutions.
Provide general GIS support by answering user questions, troubleshooting simple issues, and escalating more complex problems to senior staff.
Report to Specialist – Expert and work effectively as a team.

Skill Matrix

ArcGIS Pro Required 4 Years
ArcGIS Online Administration, Web Mapping, and Cartography Required 4 Years
Survey123, Field Maps, Experience Builder Required 2 Year
Strong oral and written communication, translation of non-GIS meetings and requests to GIS outcomes Required 4 Years
ArcGIS Enterprise Administration & Server Management Highly desired 2 Years
Arcade & Python Scripting Highly desired 2 Years
GIS for Public Safety Nice to have 2 Years

Benefits At IntelliBee

Long-Term Stability: Join us on a multi-year opportunities with room to grow.
Comprehensive Health Coverage: Access quality healthcare benefits to keep you and your family well.
Future Planning: Enroll in our 401(k) program and invest in your financial security.
GC Assistance: We support immediate Green Card processing, if required.

jobs.title: Data Analyst – Process Monitoring & Data Sciences
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Data Analyst – Process Monitoring & Data Sciences based in United States.

As a Data Analyst – Process Monitoring & Data Sciences, you will support the development and digital integration of process performance and product quality monitoring capabilities. You will work at the intersection of bioprocessing, data analytics, and digital technology to transform manufacturing and process data into actionable insights. The role combines data quality, analytics, automation, dashboard development, and scientific problem-solving. You will help modernize monitoring strategies, improve data reliability, and streamline workflows used by scientists and engineers. Working across technical and scientific teams, you will contribute to projects from initial concept through delivery. This fully remote opportunity is well suited to a quantitatively minded professional interested in applying data and technology to biopharmaceutical processes.

Accountabilities

Execute process performance and product quality monitoring activities, including Annual Product Review analytics, process monitoring documentation, control-limit calculations, and recurring monitoring deliverables.
Support the migration and digitalization of monitoring strategies and related documentation from legacy systems to updated software solutions.
Perform data-quality checks, troubleshoot data pipelines, and integrate new sources to ensure manufacturing and process-monitoring data are accurate, complete, and accessible.
Analyze and organize large and complex datasets using tools such as SQL, Python, R, Spotfire, Tableau, SIMCA, PI, and related data platforms.
Develop, enhance, automate, test, and maintain dashboards, analytical models, data products, and digital workflows supporting process development and manufacturing teams.
Troubleshoot existing analytical and digital solutions and conduct testing to ensure data products are accurate, robust, and fit for their intended use.
Explore practical applications of AI, advanced analytics, modeling, and automation to simplify scientific workflows and improve the identification and response to process signals.
Collaborate with scientists, engineers, data scientists, and other stakeholders to translate scientific and business needs into practical data solutions.
Manage assigned projects from concept through delivery while balancing multiple priorities and incorporating stakeholder feedback.
Contribute to continuous improvement of monitoring processes, data workflows, analytical solutions, and digital capabilities.

Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Life Sciences, or another quantitative discipline.
Alternatively, an Associate degree with 4 years of relevant experience, or a high school diploma/GED with 6 years of relevant experience.
Previous experience in the pharmaceutical, bioprocessing, biotechnology, or related life sciences industry.
Experience in process development, clinical or commercial manufacturing, attribute sciences, quality control, or another relevant biopharmaceutical function is preferred.
Familiarity with one or more data and analytical technologies such as SQL, Python, R, Databricks, Spotfire, Tableau, SIMCA, Aveva PI, DeltaV, or Dassault Systèmes platforms.
Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools such as Codex or Claude is beneficial.
Experience with statistical analysis, data visualization, data engineering, application development, or AI-enabled development tools is advantageous.
Strong quantitative and analytical problem-solving abilities, with careful attention to data quality and detail.
Intellectual curiosity and the ability to learn new scientific and technical concepts quickly.
Ability to work effectively across scientific, technical, and business functions.
Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities while working through ambiguous problems.
Ability to independently develop practical solutions, communicate effectively with stakeholders, and incorporate feedback to continuously improve results.

Benefits

$40–$45 per hour on a W-2 basis.
100% remote work from anywhere in the United States.
Initial 6-month contract with potential extensions.
Opportunity to work at the intersection of bioprocessing, data analytics, digital technology, and scientific innovation.
Exposure to process monitoring, manufacturing data, advanced analytics, automation, AI, and digital workflow development.
Collaboration with scientists, engineers, data scientists, and cross-functional technical teams.
Opportunity to contribute to the digitalization and modernization of scientific and manufacturing processes.
Specific healthcare, retirement, paid time off, and additional benefits were not specified in the source job description.

IMBOX is growing rapidly across North America, and we are looking for a structured and hands-on Service & Project Coordinator to join our Service & Operations team in Chicago.

In this role, you will coordinate daily shipments, installations and removals, support service requests, and keep our retail partners informed. You will also help drive projects such as new store rollouts, machine exchanges and process improvements.

You will become an important part of a young, fast-moving team where collaboration, ownership and a practical mindset are at the heart of how we work.

What you will do

Your responsibilities will include:
· Coordinating daily outbound shipments, store installations and machine removals
· Tracking shipments and maintaining accurate shipment records
· Identifying and communicating delays or issues, particularly during large installation projects
· Monitoring spare-parts inventory across multiple locations
· Supporting the coordination and follow-up of service requests and machine breakdowns
· Communicating timelines, status updates and open items to retail partners
· Supporting projects such as store rollouts, machine exchanges, upgrades and process improvements
· Maintaining operational systems and databases and ensuring that information is accurate and up to date
· Performing basic technical troubleshooting when needed
· Visiting our warehouse facilities in the Chicago suburbs when hands-on support is required
· Prior technical training is not required. We will make sure you receive the necessary training to support our machines and retail partners.

What we are looking for

You are organized, dependable and comfortable managing several tasks at the same time. You take ownership, follow through and enjoy helping both customers and colleagues find practical solutions.

We imagine that you:
· Have experience from a coordinating, customer-facing or operational role
· Are comfortable handling recurring tasks while keeping track of changing priorities and projects
· Communicate clearly and professionally with customers, partners, vendors and colleagues
· Have strong organizational skills and attention to detail
· Are confident using Microsoft Office and comfortable learning new ERP systems and databases
· Work well independently while also being a supportive team player
· Have a positive, flexible and solution-oriented mindset
· Are willing to learn basic technical support tasks and take a hands-on approach when needed
· Experience with inventory management, equipment tracking, process improvement or basic technical support is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Why join IMBOX?

IMBOX is in an exciting phase of expansion across North America. As our installed base grows, reliable service and smooth operational coordination are becoming increasingly important to the success of our retail partners and commercial teams.

You will join a collaborative environment with short decision-making paths and the opportunity to influence how we work as the organization develops. Your contribution will help keep installations, service activities and partner communication moving forward as we scale.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys structure, variety and being close to the day-to-day operations of a growing international company.

Practical details

Location: Chicago, Illinois
Employment: Full-time
Working hours: Standard 40-hour workweek, typically 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m., with flexible scheduling opportunities
Travel: Occasional travel at short notice may be required, limited to approximately 50 days per year

About IMBOX

At Imbox Protection, you're not just joining a company, you're becoming part of a fast-moving scale-up where ideas quickly become reality and your work has a visible impact from day one. We operate in a dynamic environment where growth is constant and change is embraced.

Imbox Protection is a global leader in automated protection solutions for footwear and apparel retail. Backed by a leading private equity fund, Imbox is on an ambitious international growth journey with operations in more than 40 markets worldwide.

We value curiosity, collaboration, and ownership. In return, we offer an environment where learning happens fast, decisions are made close to the business, and everyone has the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution.

new_jobs.description:
GIS Specialist, Raleigh, NC, US

Technical Specialist- Junior

NCDIT-Transportation (NCDIT-T) GIS Team is seeking a Technical Specialist – Junior that will provide dedicated support the State Traffic Operations Center (STOC) and Transportation Mobility & Safety Unit by assisting with maintaining and updating GIS data used in routing, traffic operations, and incident response. This role works with TM&S staff to understand basic workflow needs, assist with gathering requirements, and help build simple to moderately complex maps, dashboards, and GIS tools that support daily operations. The primary focus is to communicate clearly with non-GIS users, ask questions to understand requests, and follow established GIS Unit standards when creating or updating data and applications. Daily work includes editing geometry, updating events and attributing data, performing QA/QC checks, and assisting with progress tracking and documentation. The role may also support Arcade coding and help with ETL processes under guidance from more senior team members.

This position will require an advanced knowledge of ArcGIS Online, the Esri Software Suite, and ArcGIS Enterprise. The candidate must be able to build web mapping applications independently, publish hosted and referenced feature services, and understand the life cycle of GIS products from requirements gathering to databases, schema creation, cartography, application development, and maintenance.

Note: Candidates must be willing and able to perform 12+ hour days in the event of a major emergency activation, including evenings, weekends, and holidays. The ideal candidate will be able to travel to and from the STOC in Raleigh for in-person support during a major activation lasting >5 days. The State will not cover this travel expense, and it must be budgeted and supplied by the contracting firm. Candidates will be paid a flat hourly rate during approved overtime hours, if required. Preference will be given to candidates that live within <1 hour commute to STOC.

The ideal candidate will be able to shadow meetings, listen to issues, and independently identify potential GIS solutions based on complex issues. The ability to quickly generate solutions and describe them to non-IT personnel is essential to this role. Documentation, organization, and communication skills are required. This position will report to the Specialist – Expert position and must be able to take direction and work collaboratively extremely well, both in person, and remotely.

A sample of work is required as part of the submission for this position. A sample of work can include documentation of a GIS process, a cartographic map, a report on a GIS solution, or a link to a GIS application in which the candidate was the primary creator/developer.

Role/Responsibilities

Update and maintain GIS data by editing geometry, events, and attributes to support STOC and TM&S operations.
Perform routine QA/QC checks to ensure data accuracy and follow established GIS Unit workflows and standards.
Assist in creating and updating basic to moderate complexity maps, dashboards, and GIS tools used for routing, signal operations, incident response, and situational awareness.
Work with TM&S staff to understand their requests, ask clarifying questions, and document requirements in a clear and simple way.
Write basic Arcade code to support mapping, queries, calculations, and display.
Support ETL processes under guidance from senior GIS staff, helping keep data and applications up to date.
Attend STOC meetings to observe workflows and learn operational needs, gradually building the context needed to support the future GIS solutions.
Provide general GIS support by answering user questions, troubleshooting simple issues, and escalating more complex problems to senior staff.
Report to Specialist – Expert and work effectively as a team.

Skill Matrix

ArcGIS Pro Required 4 Years
ArcGIS Online Administration, Web Mapping, and Cartography Required 4 Years
Survey123, Field Maps, Experience Builder Required 2 Year
Strong oral and written communication, translation of non-GIS meetings and requests to GIS outcomes Required 4 Years
ArcGIS Enterprise Administration & Server Management Highly desired 2 Years
Arcade & Python Scripting Highly desired 2 Years
GIS for Public Safety Nice to have 2 Years

Future Planning: Enroll in our 401(k) program and invest in your financial security.

new_jobs.title: Service & Project Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
Ready to help keep our growing U.S. operations running smoothly?

IMBOX is growing rapidly across North America, and we are looking for a structured and hands-on Service & Project Coordinator to join our Service & Operations team in Chicago.

In this role, you will coordinate daily shipments, installations and removals, support service requests, and keep our retail partners informed. You will also help drive projects such as new store rollouts, machine exchanges and process improvements.

You will become an important part of a young, fast-moving team where collaboration, ownership and a practical mindset are at the heart of how we work.

What you will do

Your responsibilities will include:
· Coordinating daily outbound shipments, store installations and machine removals
· Tracking shipments and maintaining accurate shipment records
· Identifying and communicating delays or issues, particularly during large installation projects
· Monitoring spare-parts inventory across multiple locations
· Supporting the coordination and follow-up of service requests and machine breakdowns
· Communicating timelines, status updates and open items to retail partners
· Supporting projects such as store rollouts, machine exchanges, upgrades and process improvements
· Maintaining operational systems and databases and ensuring that information is accurate and up to date
· Performing basic technical troubleshooting when needed
· Visiting our warehouse facilities in the Chicago suburbs when hands-on support is required
· Prior technical training is not required. We will make sure you receive the necessary training to support our machines and retail partners.

What we are looking for

You are organized, dependable and comfortable managing several tasks at the same time. You take ownership, follow through and enjoy helping both customers and colleagues find practical solutions.

We imagine that you:
· Have experience from a coordinating, customer-facing or operational role
· Are comfortable handling recurring tasks while keeping track of changing priorities and projects
· Communicate clearly and professionally with customers, partners, vendors and colleagues
· Have strong organizational skills and attention to detail
· Are confident using Microsoft Office and comfortable learning new ERP systems and databases
· Work well independently while also being a supportive team player
· Have a positive, flexible and solution-oriented mindset
· Are willing to learn basic technical support tasks and take a hands-on approach when needed
· Experience with inventory management, equipment tracking, process improvement or basic technical support is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Why join IMBOX?

IMBOX is in an exciting phase of expansion across North America. As our installed base grows, reliable service and smooth operational coordination are becoming increasingly important to the success of our retail partners and commercial teams.

You will join a collaborative environment with short decision-making paths and the opportunity to influence how we work as the organization develops. Your contribution will help keep installations, service activities and partner communication moving forward as we scale.

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys structure, variety and being close to the day-to-day operations of a growing international company.

Practical details

Location: Chicago, Illinois
Employment: Full-time
Working hours: Standard 40-hour workweek, typically 9:00 a.m.–5:00 p.m., with flexible scheduling opportunities
Travel: Occasional travel at short notice may be required, limited to approximately 50 days per year

About IMBOX

At Imbox Protection, you're not just joining a company, you're becoming part of a fast-moving scale-up where ideas quickly become reality and your work has a visible impact from day one. We operate in a dynamic environment where growth is constant and change is embraced.

Imbox Protection is a global leader in automated protection solutions for footwear and apparel retail. Backed by a leading private equity fund, Imbox is on an ambitious international growth journey with operations in more than 40 markets worldwide.

We value curiosity, collaboration, and ownership. In return, we offer an environment where learning happens fast, decisions are made close to the business, and everyone has the opportunity to make a meaningful contribution.
